title: Federated Vector Retrieval across Heterogeneous VectorDBs
abstract: arXiv:2611.01514v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vector databases are now core infrastructure for AI retrieval systems, yet many real deployments must serve queries over multiple independently constructed vectorDBs built with different embedding models. This creates a systems problem of federated retrieval over heterogeneous vectorDBs: vectors and similarity scores are not directly comparable across embedding spaces, while fully resolving this incompatibility through corpus-wide re-embedding and re-indexing is often operationally prohibitive. Existing methods therefore face a difficult trade-off between retrieval quality, construction cost, and query throughput. We present HVMap, a lightweight compatibility layer for federated retrieval across heterogeneous vectorDBs. translated_title: 跨异构向量数据库的联邦向量检索
translated_abstract: 向量数据库如今已成为AI检索系统的核心基础设施，然而许多实际部署中需要对多个独立构建的向量数据库进行查询，而这些数据库采用了不同的嵌入模型构建。这带来了一个在异构向量数据库上进行联邦检索的系统难题：向量与相似度分数在不同嵌入空间之间无法直接比较，而通过全库重新嵌入和重新索引来彻底解决这种不兼容性，在运营上往往代价过高。因此，现有方法在检索质量、构建成本和查询吞吐量之间面临艰难的权衡。我们提出了HVMap，一个用于跨异构向量数据库联邦检索的轻量级兼容层。HVMap无需将数据库重建到统一空间，而是利用模糊对比损失学习嵌入空间之间的双向映射，从而在无需语料库迁移的情况下实现经过校准的跨数据库评分。
tldr: HVMap通过模糊对比损失学习不同嵌入空间之间的双向映射，在无需重新嵌入或迁移语料库的情况下，实现了跨异构向量数据库的高质量联邦检索。
en_tdlr: HVMap learns bidirectional mappings between embedding spaces via a fuzzy contrastive loss, enabling high-quality federated retrieval across heterogeneous vector databases without costly re-embedding or corpus migration.
